food-plum-blossom-cake.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Nanjing meihuagao plum-blossom molded hot cakes: three small upright cup-shaped baked batter cakes, each with a shallow five-lobed flower-shaped opening and toasted golden-brown sides. The open top reveals dark red bean paste, crowned with several tiny pearly-white glutinous rice balls, a few golden raisins, one small red date piece and a light scattering of sesame seeds. One half cake shows its soft cooked flour-batter walls enclosing dark red bean paste. Traditional Chinese street snack, not a mooncake, not transparent green jelly or kueh, no icing, no sugar-flower decorations, no Western cupcakes.
